body: So are we having a chance that this gets fixed in a 0.4.3 in end of December or beginning of January? We would like to upgrade to 0.4 but are mostly sticking to 0.3 due to bugs.
They are using the same code path. There's a whole package with over 1k LOC they call into. But those two methods do share like several lines that I guess could be refactored to be common.
@jart Since I am a big fan of only "fool me once" I propose to merge the rest, too: https://bazel-review.googlesource.com/#/c/7892/

issue.title: "Invalid EvalException" from Bazel when building Tensorflow on Mac OS X

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system
